title: Digital Arrest & Fake Police/Customs Threat
description: Scammers impersonate police officers, CBI, ED, or Customs officials over video calls (Skype/WhatsApp) claiming an illegal package or warrant is linked to your Aadhaar/passport, forcing victims into 'digital arrest'.
immediate_actions: 🚨 Hang up immediately! Real law enforcement agencies (Police, CBI, Customs, ED) NEVER issue warrants or conduct trials over video calls.
📞 Verify credentials independently by calling your local police station or official government landlines.
🚫 Do NOT transfer money into 'verification' or 'escrow' accounts demanded by fake officers.
📝 Report the caller number, video screenshots, and UPI IDs on https://cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
source: Official National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (1930) & MHA Cyber Dost Advisory

title: Banking Credentials / OTP / PIN Compromise
description: Scammers trick victims into revealing OTPs, UPI PINs, passwords, or CVV under the guise of KYC updates, bank account unblocking, or card activation.
immediate_actions: 🚨 Contact your bank's emergency fraud helpline IMMEDIATELY to block credit/debit cards and disable net banking.
📱 Change passwords for net banking, UPI apps (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm), and email accounts.
⏱️ Act within the 'Golden Hour' (first 1-2 hours) and call 1930 to file a financial cyber fraud report for account freezing.
🔒 Never share OTPs or PINs. Legitimate bank officials will NEVER ask for your OTP or PIN.
source: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Guidelines & National Cybercrime Helpline 1930

title: Phishing Link & Malicious APK Installation
description: Victims click deceptive links in SMS, WhatsApp, or email that lead to fake login pages or download malicious Android APKs designed to steal SMS OTPs and credentials.
immediate_actions: 🌐 Disconnect Wi-Fi and mobile data immediately to stop active data exfiltration.
🔑 Change passwords for all sensitive accounts (email, banking) from a SEPARATE, clean device.
📱 Inspect installed apps for recent unknown APKs (e.g. AnyDesk, QuickSupport, fake banking apps) and uninstall them.
🛡️ Clear browser cache, cookies, and perform a full antivirus device scan.
source: CERT-In Cyber Security Advisory & Cyber Crime Safety Protocol

title: Financial Loss & Fraudulent Transfer Recovery Protocol
description: Victim has already sent money to a scammer via UPI, IMPS, NEFT, or card payment.
immediate_actions: 🚨 Dial National Cybercrime Helpline 1930 immediately! Reporting within the 'Golden Hour' allows police to freeze destination bank accounts before scammers cash out.
📞 Contact your bank's fraud reporting desk to request a payment reversal / chargeback under RBI fraudulent transaction protocols.
📄 Preserve all evidence: transaction reference numbers, UTR IDs, screenshots of chats, call logs, and receipts.
🚔 File a formal online complaint at https://cybercrime.gov.in and register an FIR at the nearest Cyber Crime Cell.
source: RBI Circular on Customer Protection in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions & Helpline 1930

title: AI Voice Cloning & Family Emergency Impersonation
description: Scammers use AI deepfake voice cloning to replicate the voice of a relative, friend, or child claiming an emergency (accident, arrest, distress) and demanding immediate money transfers.
immediate_actions: 📞 Hang up and call your family member or friend directly on their known, regular mobile number.
👥 Set up a private 'family safe word' that scammers cannot know to verify identity in emergency calls.
🚫 Never transfer funds to unknown UPI IDs or third-party bank accounts provided over an unexpected call.
⚠️ Block the incoming number and alert family members about target impersonation.
source: Cyber Fraud Defense Task Force & AI Deepfake Safety Advisory

title: Part-Time Task & Fake Crypto Investment Scam
description: Victims are lured via WhatsApp/Telegram with promises of easy income for liking YouTube videos or reviewing hotels, then coerced into depositing large sums for high-return 'prepaid tasks' or fake crypto trading.
immediate_actions: 🚨 Stop transferring any further money! Scammers will make endless excuses demanding 'tax' or 'unlock fees' to release profits.
🚫 Exit suspicious Telegram channels and block numbers offering unsolicited work-from-home tasks.
📄 Export and save all Telegram chat histories, wallet addresses, bank receipts, and transaction records.
📝 Report the fraudulent investment portal and banking details on https://cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.
source: MHA Cyber Dost Advisory on Telegram & Investment Scams
